expense_allocations_project_target_has_p.name: expense_allocations_project_target_has_project
expense_allocations_project_target_has_p.value:
("expense_allocations"."target_type" = 'project' and "expense_allocations"."project_id" is not null)
          or ("expense_allocations"."target_type" = 'overhead' and "expense_allocations"."project_id" is null)

expenses_work_package_requires_project.name: expenses_work_package_requires_project
expenses_work_package_requires_project.value: "expenses"."work_package_id" is null or "expenses"."project_id" is not null

labor_cost_components_basis_value.name: labor_cost_components_basis_value
labor_cost_components_basis_value.value:
("labor_cost_components"."basis" = 'amount' and "labor_cost_components"."amount" is not null and "labor_cost_components"."currency" is not null)
          or ("labor_cost_components"."basis" = 'percent' and "labor_cost_components"."percent" is not null)

time_entries_kind_target.name: time_entries_kind_target
time_entries_kind_target.value:
("time_entries"."kind" = 'project' and "time_entries"."project_id" is not null)
          or ("time_entries"."kind" = 'non_project' and "time_entries"."project_id" is null)
